description.zh: 校准后的抖音普通视频页控制。开始前 configure_profile、start_control。仅用户明确要求时调用。点赞/收藏先 inspect_page 获取 expected_video_key；不要根据猜测补参数。unverified 不得重试点击或声称成功。停止不关闭宿主麦克风。
description.en: Calibrated Douyin controls. Configure and start first. Act only on explicit user requests. Inspect before like/favorite; never invent video tokens. Never retry an unverified touch or claim success. Stop does not close the host microphone.

description.zh: 只读检查前台页面并获取当前 video_key。include_nodes 默认 false；用户明确同意校准采样时才设 true，屏幕文字将作为工具结果传给模型。
description.en: Read current page and video token. Node export requires explicit calibration consent and may transmit screen text to the model.

parameters.name: include_nodes
parameters.description: 显式导出屏幕节点用于校准，默认 false / Export screen nodes, default false

description.zh: 安装用户核对过的本机页面校准 JSON。不得编造选择器、包名或屏幕尺寸。配置会停止当前会话。
description.en: Install a user-verified device profile. Never invent selectors, package names or viewport dimensions. Stops the session.

parameters.name: profile_json
parameters.description: 符合 profiles/example.json 结构的真实设备配置 JSON 字符串 / Device profile JSON string

description.zh: 用户明确要求开始时开启最长 30 分钟控制会话，不启动录音。请先完成页面校准。
description.en: Start a 30-minute control session on explicit request after calibration. Does not start microphone recording.

parameters.name: wake_word
parameters.description: 严格文本入口唤醒词，默认小刷；空串仅供用户指定的无唤醒词测试 / Wake word, default 小刷

description.zh: 立即禁用本插件会话，不等待动作锁；已提交触摸不能撤销。宿主语音监听需另行关闭。
description.en: Disable session immediately without waiting for action lock. Submitted touches cannot be recalled; stop host voice separately.

description.zh: 普通视频页单次上滑。用户每个独立请求使用独立 command_id，重试同一请求复用 ID。结果无法确认时不得自动重试。
description.en: Swipe up once. Use a unique ID per user request and reuse it for retries. Never retry an unverified action.

parameters.name: command_id
parameters.description: 本会话请求唯一 ID，字母数字短横线等 / Unique request ID

parameters.name: expected_video_key
parameters.description: inspect_page 返回的视频比较 token / Observed video token

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: start_control 返回的会话 ID / Session ID

description.zh: 普通视频页单次下滑，不能保证抖音仍保留上一视频。无法确认时不得自动重试。
description.en: Swipe down once. Previous video availability depends on Douyin. Never retry an unverified action.

parameters.name: command_id
parameters.description: 本会话请求唯一 ID / Unique request ID

parameters.name: expected_video_key
parameters.description: inspect_page 返回的视频 token / Observed video token

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: 会话 ID / Session ID

description.zh: 确保当前视频已点赞，不取消已有点赞。必须先 inspect_page 获取 video_key；状态不明时拒绝，不盲点。
description.en: Ensure liked without toggling off. Inspect first for video_key. Unknown state is rejected.

parameters.name: command_id
parameters.description: 本会话请求唯一 ID / Unique request ID

parameters.name: expected_video_key
parameters.description: inspect_page.analysis.video_key，禁止编造 / Observed token, never invent

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: 会话 ID / Session ID

description.zh: 确保当前视频已收藏，不取消已有收藏。必须先 inspect_page 获取 video_key；出现未知收藏面板则无法确认，不自动处理。
description.en: Ensure favorited without toggling off. Inspect first. Unknown collection dialogs are not operated.

parameters.name: command_id
parameters.description: 本会话请求唯一 ID / Unique request ID

parameters.name: expected_video_key
parameters.description: inspect_page.analysis.video_key，禁止编造 / Observed token, never invent

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: 会话 ID / Session ID

description.zh: 供 ASR/工作流适配器直接提交完整转写，严格匹配，不需要 LLM。普通聊天请调用具体动作。时间必须是 Android elapsedRealtime 同基准，不可用 Unix 时间。
description.en: Direct strict ASR/workflow entry; no LLM needed. Use Android elapsedRealtime milliseconds, never Unix timestamps. Chat should use action tools.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: start_control 返回的会话 ID / Session ID

parameters.name: utterance_id
parameters.description: 独立语句 ID，重复回调复用 / Stable utterance ID

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: 完整识别文本 / Complete transcript

parameters.name: final
parameters.description: 是否为最终结果 / Final result flag

parameters.name: issued_at_ms
parameters.description: 捕获最终结果时的 Android 单调时钟毫秒 / elapsedRealtime at final result

parameters.name: expected_video_key
parameters.description: 捕获命令时的视频 token / Video token at command capture
